entries.text: Increases health by 400 points. Increases all defences by 35 points.

In basic attack, every 6 seconds, you can trigger a heavy attack with high [icon] and [icon] effects. This attack applies [icon] to the units, reducing their [illegible — icon-embedded gap in source card image].

After every 3 attacks, the next attack's damage will be increased by 11%. Every 6 attacks, 15% maximum health will be restored. Every 9 [illegible — source card image clips before this doctrine's remainder renders].
Increases all types of damage inflicted in sieges by 8%.

entries.text: Units that can kite it, or heavy-burst units (e.g. Queen’s Knights, Yorkist).
Debuff units (Rattan Pikes); big-range units like Phalanx or Stalwart if they kite well.
Any block units; deals insane damage to units like Spartans / Imperial Spear Guards.

steps.context: blob fight / vs brace units, can't burst (most cases)
steps.text: Full Sword stance (Devastation on engage if available). X-move in, use the heavy-armour passive (wait for a CC or a few hits before pressing Tiger Step).
Press 2 for damage + CC immunity; also resets the damage-reduction trait (press early if CC is incoming).
Wait for the enemy to hit you enough to trigger the passive, or let Tiger Step expire (12s); reset the passive again via Charge into a C-cancelled auto-attack, or X+V if the hero can stay close.

steps.context: 1v1 / vs a blocking unit — rarely used but good to know
steps.text: Start with flails; close and charge so the enemy can't sidestep (use Devastation before swapping weapons if available).

Switch to swords and click Tiger Step to skip the weapon-swap animation; leave the unit to fight until the target dies before resetting (can back off early). Only worth it when you can kill rapidly, or in a skirmish vs a blocking unit — otherwise the heavy-armour trait goes unused. Helps the hero break shield formations or stun high-DPS units.
Pressing C (follow) cancels the auto-attack animation, improving trades vs Stalwart or Claymore (more DPS for allies too) — train in custom battle first.
The heavy-armour trait works against artillery (trebuchet counts as artillery in-game) — press Charge to tank a trebuchet shot if the heavy trait is not currently active.
